title: Enterprise Center US-001..US-045 full-runtime acceptance map

runtime_environment.notification: Notification Runtime; in-app path always real; external provider qualification is separate #185 boundary

evidence_boundaries.browser: CE-12 uses real IdP/BFF/Biz API/MySQL; ordinary web/e2e tests are UI contract evidence and are not relabeled as CE-12.
evidence_boundaries.event_source: US-045 business-event ingress is qualification-only TestEnterprise189AppendControlledBusinessEvent using the production BusinessEventPublisher contract. Production exposes no browser event-fabrication endpoint.
evidence_boundaries.external_provider: Third-party SMS/email provider sandbox qualification is not claimed here; #185 remains BLOCKED_BY_EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION_INPUT for that external dependency.
evidence_boundaries.performance: #189 is Full Runtime integration and explicitly does not replace later full security/performance qualification; #191 owns aggregate performance qualification.

negative_contracts.claim: protected routes fail closed; direct API remains server-authorized; #189 proves old viewer session receives 403 on the next member request after revocation
stale session/CAS/replay/protected lifecycle conflicts are explicit and do not fabricate success
member appeal rate limit returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After from the real BFF handler
controlled real persistence/provider failure paths retain explicit failed state/rollback; no demo-success fallback
acknowledged writes remain unconfirmed until authoritative GET recovery; uncertain retry reuses identity/idempotency rather than reporting fake success

cross_cutting.note: #116/#117/#131/#133 remain outside #189; this map does not claim their implementation.
